event_location.address: 1475 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 2A1, Canada

event_short_description: Stephen Boyd (sspboyd) is hosting a talk about using Processing over the course of his 20+ years of making rule-based generative art. The event is held at the GAS gallery where Stephen's work will be on display.  RSVP: https://luma.com/c2dhptky

intake.maintainer_notes:
Hey there. Here's my thinking for the PCD Toronto event so far:

1. A hands-on p5.js workshop, “Rules, Randomness, Repeatability,” during the first two weeks of October. The workshop will be targeted for beginner to intermediate level of Processing knowledge.
2. A talk and open studio at GAS, with generative work made using Processing on the walls as live examples of a 25-year generative practice.

I have a gallery to host the workshop at and we can do the talk there as well. The gallery is called GAS (Gerrard Art Space) in Toronto. 

I know Nick Fox-Grieg is also interested in helping out so we might add to the events if he's up for something else too.
